title: Berry Oat Breakfast Smoothie
description: Creamy berries, banana, yogurt, and oats make a filling breakfast smoothie.

steps.text: Add 1 cup frozen mixed berries, 0.5 banana, 0.5 cup plain Greek yogurt, 0.5 cup milk or nondairy milk, and 0.25 cup rolled oats to the blender. Blend until completely smooth; add a small splash of the recipe liquid if you want it thinner.
Taste before sweetening. For a sweeter taste, add 1 tsp honey or maple syrup as desired, and blend again briefly.

description: A sweet meal-sized flatbread for breakfast or lunch.

Sprinkle with cinnamon and drizzle with honey if desired.
